fields.claim: I can survey the East Ward main street notices on two weekends.
fields.uncertainty: I cannot say how many notices exist.
fields.offered_work: I can read the posted works notices on the main street and record the contact field.
fields.role_capacity: Volunteer surveyor, about six hours a month.
fields.limits: I cannot work with electrical equipment.
fields.lawful_basis: Reading public notices from the pavement needs no permit.

fields.claim: I surveyed the first half of the main street notices.
fields.uncertainty: Some notices may have been removed before I came.
fields.done: Read and recorded the notices on the north half of the street.
fields.not_done: The south half is not surveyed.
fields.next_step: Survey the south half next weekend.

fields.claim: The survey sheet shows how many notices name a contact point.

evidence_refs.supports: The shared sheet with one row per notice.

fields.uncertainty: The sheet covers two weekends only.
fields.metric_addressed: Share of works notices that name a resident contact point.
fields.what_it_does_not_show: It does not show whether the contact points were answered.

evidence_refs.description: The shared sheet with one row per notice and its contact field.

fields.outcome_statement: The sheet shows how many of the surveyed notices name a contact point.
fields.what_the_evidence_does_not_show: It covers one street and two weekends only.
